doctrine.aliases: version-unpinned. sonnet/opus/fable/haiku are platform aliases; the platform resolves each to the provider-recommended version, and resolution can legitimately differ by provider, ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_*_MODEL, CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL, availableModels allowlists, org restrictions, and modelOverrides. Kiln never resolves a Claude alias and never claims which concrete version will serve; it records the RESOLVED identity per run from the modelUsage keys of the archived stream-json result events. gpt-sol names the codex transport model via the resolver below — codex -m requires a concrete id, so the one versioned string in the product lives there and nowhere else.
doctrine.degradation: no silent model substitution: a broken or unavailable codex transport degrades the cross-family KEY to the claude family, never the process itself, and every affected seal is labeled single-family honestly. The dual moments still run — both seats drawn from the claude family (fable + opus as the two minds). The trigger is codex unavailable; the FIRST detection at any ratify/audit gate is the acknowledgment stop (the detector records .kiln/degraded alone; the operator answers continue and the conductor writes .kiln/degraded-ack, the one writer of that file), never a silent single-family seal; the acked re-run completes single-family — fable authors the LAW and a fresh OPUS ratifies it (opposite model, same family), one fresh OPUS goal-backward mind audits each milestone, and logic/mixed slices are sonnet-built and opus-reviewed. The fallback-reviewer seat carries the codex-absent LAW-ratify and milestone-audit duties; the LAW seals with the digest-bound .kiln/law/lock.seal label sidecar, and every seals.log and audits.log line records the family. An unacknowledged degradation never proceeds and never silently seals — the first detection is the acknowledgment stop, and only the operator continue enters the claude fallback.
doctrine.xhigh: the effort floor is HIGH: a model-backed role defaults high — a truly mechanical job takes no model, not a cheap one — and validateTiers rejects any sub-HIGH seat among the roles the kernel consumes — TIER_ROLES and every surface_routing target; a key outside that set has no consumer and is not validated. xhigh is permitted only for extremely-complex, all-layers, global-vision work, selected deliberately per artifact — never required, never a standing default, never laddered on one artifact. ONE role-keyed exception exists: vision-check runs MEDIUM, the operator locked word in INTAKE-36(a); it is additive and per-role (kernel.js TIER_EFFORT_EXCEPTIONS), never a global drop, and every other seat keeps the HIGH floor.
doctrine.seats: seat philosophy: the thinking seats — the big decisions and slice creation, stage-law — run Fable 5, the strongest mind (opus in succession); the donkey work is cost-optimized — GPT-5.6 as the main coder for logic and mixed, Opus implementing ui and creative pieces perfectly from a well-defined Fable plan.

driver.note: the operator's session model — Kiln never overrides it

kernel-leg.note: hands/idsFetch — the kernel's model-backed transport legs. Every leg is fixed-command and schema-forced, and every trust property (kernel-side hands, receipt evidence) is model-independent, so sonnet carries the transport at a fraction of the session-model cost. Interim seat by design: the ruled end state is deterministic harness execution — no model call at all — and this seat retires when that lands. tiers:boot is out of scope by construction (no tier values exist before the file is read).

stage-card.note: validate/report card agents and the claude gate leg — the `act` default for every stage but LAW (the LAW stage resolves through stage-law). The build SLICE leg (build + repair) is NOT stage-card: the kernel surface-routes it to builder-ui/builder-logic before agent().

stage-law.note: the thinking seat — slice creation and the law. W3: also the VISION MERGE seat — it reads the blind plans and their records under .kiln/plans/ and writes the merged vision, the last word on the vision moment (INTAKE-36). Fable preferred: the platform resolves the fable alias to the strongest Fable-class mind; opus is the recorded succession when a platform lacks fable — flip the alias here, one file, one line.

builder-ui.note: CONSUMED via surface_routing at the KERNEL's builder-leg dispatch: the kernel selects the role from the slice's surface BEFORE agent(), never the already-dispatched card. Live routing data, not a reserved key. Opus implements the interfaces and creative pieces from the locked plan; fable is reserved for the thinking seats.

builder-logic.note: the claude context-builder seat whose CODER is GPT-5.6 via ONE bash codex exec call per cards/build.md and references/codex-prompt-guide.md — the resolver names the concrete id (gpt-sol); coder effort high (named once here — build.md and the guide cite this note, never a hardcoded value). The claude-family route-target boot rule holds BY DESIGN: the agent() spawner sees only this sonnet wrapper; codex rides a bash call with stdin closed by the prompt redirect. Cross-family law downstream: GPT coded the slice, so its gate is a fresh claude reviewer in the kernel, never codex; the wrapper effort and the coder effort are separate facts, both high.

reviewer-gate.note: the cross-family terminal gate (scripts/kiln-review transport) for ui slices — a logic or mixed slice is GPT-coded, so its gate is a fresh claude mind in the kernel (cross-family law). REMIT: at the BUILD gate, after Opus builds the ui, GPT reviews correctness against the locked criteria ONLY — creative direction, visual taste, and aesthetic choices are the Opus builder's and stay out of the build-gate remit, never a build finding; the prompt enforces it in scripts/kiln-review. SCREENING ROOM (W8): the same seat is the perceptual PRIMARY grader whenever any perceptual owner is ui-surfaced — Opus-built pixels earn a fresh GPT eye. It grades the LAW perceptual table rows against the shipped data/perceptual-rubric.json over captured evidence; that graded subjective residue is the duty, so the taste exclusion is scoped to the build-gate context and does not reach the screening room.

fallback-reviewer.note: the codex-absent fallback reviewer: sonnet builds, OPUS reviews cross-context — the best split without a second family. DEGRADED PATH: when a logic or mixed slice was built single-family because codex was down, the kernel convenes a fresh opus mind — a different, stronger model than the sonnet builder, same family and fresh context — for the SAME full validation the normal claude gate runs; the seal still reads the .kiln/degraded marker at seal time and stays single-family. A boot-required consumer key (kernel.js TIER_ROLES): the kernel resolves it through tier() at the degraded gate, so the boot gate demands it and fails closed with the named configuration fact when it is absent — never a later throw when codex dies mid-run. SCREENING ROOM (W8): the same opus seat carries the perceptual claude leg — the PRIMARY grader when every perceptual owner is GPT-coded (logic/mixed surfaces, the fresh-mind family rule), and the perceptual SECOND grader on the bounded opposite-family escalation of a semantic hold. On the acked degraded path the same opus seat also carries the codex-absent LAW-ratify and milestone-audit duties — a fresh opus ratifies the fable-authored LAW (opposite model, same family, plus a post-turn tamper check since a claude agent can write) and a fresh opus goal-backward mind audits each milestone, both mirroring the codex packet, digest and lineage rules and sealing honestly single-family; research-sweep consumes the same seat for the codex-absent feasibility ratify. W3 DEGRADED ORGAN: when codex is down the same opus seat carries the second blind plan authorship, the degraded vision check and the degraded master merge — only the cross-family KEY degrades, never the dual moment itself.

ratify-reviewer.note: the always-on cross-family LAW-ratify gate, consumed by the kernel at the law stage: after the claude/fable stage-law seat authors the candidate LAW, a fresh OPPOSITE-family mind ratifies it against data/law-rubric.json through scripts/kiln-review ratify, and only on accept does the kernel seal the LAW (seal-law) and let build begin. Opposite-family to stage-law by design — the second key on the plan; codex -m needs the concrete id, so it resolves through gpt-sol like the other gpt seats. A boot-required consumer key (kernel.js TIER_ROLES): a tiers.json missing it fails the run closed with the named configuration fact, never a later throw. When codex is down the ratify TRANSPORT degrades to the claude family: the first detection is the acknowledgment stop, and the acked re-run ratifies through the fallback-reviewer opus seat, sealed honestly single-family — the cross-family key degrades, never the ratification. A reviewer block or non-convergence inside the repair cap is still an operator HELD.

brainstorm-facilitator.note: Da Vinci — inherits the session model (agents/da-vinci.md ships no model key and stays that way; the sub-agents contract defaults to inherit)

haiku-migration.note: STRICTLY the explicit haiku-class migration seat (haiku resolves to sonnet). The HIGH floor binds it like every seat — never a justification for LOW on any model-backed role. No consumer today — the landing pad for any surviving haiku-class seat.

dev-sol.note: dev-process Sol reviews (scripts/dev/sol-review.sh defaults match); xhigh deliberate-only

plan-author.note: the organ's gpt authorship seat, consumed through the plan-act verb: the blind plan drafts, their revisions, AND the master merge. ONE seat for all three because the merge IS plan authorship at the same family, alias and effort — a second identical tuple would be a seat minted for a name. Ground: INTAKE-36 seats gpt-sol at HIGH as the author and names the merge explicitly. Reusing ratify-reviewer is refused — authorship on a seat named reviewer crosses the duty-class line the attestation layer itself draws.

vision-check.note: the vision-completeness check: gpt-sol grades the merged vision against data/omission-rubric.json through the ratify verb with family word vision — an omission verdict only, never a re-litigation of substance. Ground: INTAKE-36(a) verbatim, including MEDIUM, which is the ONE role-keyed exception to the HIGH floor (kernel.js TIER_EFFORT_EXCEPTIONS).

master-check.note: the master-plan completeness check: a fresh sonnet mind grades the merged master plan against the same data/omission-rubric.json through the shared claude-check closure, family word master. Ground: INTAKE-36(b) verbatim. kernel-leg is refused for this duty — its note scopes it to mechanical transport, and a check is a judgment.
